title.en: Local workflow with live local-model agent
title.zh: 接入本地模型 agent 的本地流程

body.en: prototype/server.py serves a Python standard-library app with SQLite records and a browser UI. In live mode, the home server's local Gemma 4 26B-A4B model (LM Studio) reads the request, identifies missing or ambiguous information, selects permitted lookup/calculation tools, quotes the customer's own words and prepares the clarification or owner task. Application code validates every tool call, calculates money/dates and writes every fact in the owner brief from typed fields with their sources. The agent gives no approve/decline recommendation (no owner policy exists). The owner commits every decision; replies are templates and are never sent. Mock and unavailable modes remain for controlled tests. Fictional data only; no business accuracy or time saving is established. See prototype/README.md, PROMPTS.md and docs/DEPLOYMENT.md. Code is on a draft work branch, not merged main. Since 17 October the interface is a case desk: a list beside one case, a due-date timeline drawn from the calculated facts, and one action panel per role. A demo console (operator code, fictional data only) resets the demo with a backup and can undo it.
body.zh: prototype/server.py 提供 Python 标准库服务、SQLite 记录与网页。live 模式下，家用服务器上的本地 Gemma 4 26B-A4B 模型（LM Studio）负责读取请求、识别缺失或含糊信息、选择获准的查询/计算工具、原文引用客户的话，并准备补信息或老板审批任务。应用代码校验每次工具调用、计算金额与日期，并以带来源的类型化字段写出老板简报中的每项事实。agent 不给出批准/拒绝建议（尚无老板政策）。所有决定由老板提交，回复为模板且不会发送。mock 与 unavailable 模式保留用于受控测试。仅使用虚构数据，未证明业务准确性或节省时间。见 prototype/README.md、PROMPTS.md 与 docs/DEPLOYMENT.md；代码在草稿工作分支，尚未合并 main。 自 10 月 17 日起，界面改为案件工作台：列表与单个案件并列，依据计算事实绘制到期日时间线，每个角色只有一个操作面板。演示控制台（操作员代码，仅限虚构数据）可在备份后重置演示数据，并可撤销。

bullets.en: 19–20 October: on branch explore/agent-coordinator-20261019 (not merged, not deployed; the shared site still runs f95f50f), the first slice of P003 is built (E018). Requests becomes a desk: one input, a general thread and one thread per case, with cards for facts, what the owner said, the owner's questions and the decision. The old list view and form stay at #/cases and #/cases/new. What the owner says is kept as said, confirmed once, owner-only unless shared, and used with its scope and date. Code decides which of the agent's questions reach the owner, and the questions never block the decision. An advisory suggestion (E017) is off by default, owner-only, withheld while a question is open, and stored apart from the decision. Staff can ask what a customer owes, which invoices are open, a request's status and what the owner shared, and code writes every number. Model access: one OpenAI-compatible adapter, tested only against the local model; hosted endpoints untested. Checks on fictional data after the final review's fixes: unit suite 333, desk 48/48, layout 174/174, interface 150/150, guide 58/58 with the live model (old pages), effort comparison 17/17, and a live-model check of the coordinator's tasks through the desk API, 18/18 and 20/20 in two runs (in one run code withheld a suggestion that cited a malformed id). In the effort comparison (mock agent) the owner's actions did not fall (S1 4→4, S2 5→6) and the staff question needed no page (2→0). Real-world value, decision quality and the live model's quality in the new tasks are not established. Guide revision 4 is pending. Next: a team review on a local preview, then a deploy decision.

Known limits: owner actions did not fall in the effort comparison, guide revision 4 is pending, no hosted model is tested, the suggestion is advisory and unevaluated, and two scenarios are unbuilt.
bullets.zh: 10 月 20 日：agent-coordinator 分支以独立预览实例运行于 https://nucleon.dracooz.top/preview/（9cc6d75；E019），使用同一个本地真实模型和虚构样例，有自己的数据库、访问码和 cookie，供团队在浏览器中审查工作台，再决定是否部署；根路径 / 的共享实例仍运行 f95f50f。首次真实模型运行之后（提示版本 coordinator-v0.2），代码会删除向老板索要决定本身的问题，建议失败时会说明原因，建议的日期也不得超过老板说过的天数上限。已知局限：工作量对比中老板的操作次数没有减少，第 4 版测试指南待写，托管模型未测试，建议仅供参考且未经评估，另有两个场景未实现。

bullets.en: 20 October, later: on the team's direction of that day (a natural working conversation; combine tools; permissions and calculations in code; answer first; simplify; prepare actions; both hosted and local models; validate with varied wording), the desk becomes conversational (E020; P003 Revision 3; prompt coordinator-v0.3). The four-category router is replaced by one bounded tool-calling run per message: the model gathers with read tools over the records, context and cases, points to where things are done, prepares a customer for the person to create, and writes the answer first; code guards every sentence (amounts only with their certainty mark, counts and dates only as the tools returned them, no claims of action) and writes every figure in the cards. Each thread keeps a current customer per role. The owner's case thread puts the decision first; staff see one status line. Checks on fictional data: unit suite 372, desk 60/60, 13 scripted conversations 169/169 on the mock and 170/170 on the local live model with no reply withheld. The rubric's reader is a model and the human column is empty; no hosted model is tested; guide revision 4 is pending. Deployed to the preview only (65982b8): through the public URL with the live model, the three-part ask, follow-up, switch, navigation, adding a customer and the owner's context passed; for a request beyond the owner's "up to 14 days", one suggestion named the current due date and was withheld by code, the other, after the owner's answer, stayed within the limit. The shared site at / still runs f95f50f.
bullets.zh: 10 月 20 日稍后：按团队当天的方向（自然的工作对话；组合工具；权限与计算留在代码中；先回答；简化；准备好操作；托管与本地模型都要支持；用不同措辞验证），工作台改为对话式（E020；P003 第 3 版；提示版本 coordinator-v0.3）。四类路由被替换为每条消息一次有上限的工具调用：模型用只读工具查询记录、上下文和案件，指出操作所在位置，为用户准备待创建的客户，并先给出回答；代码检查每一句话（金额必须带确定性标记，数量和日期必须与工具返回一致，不得声称已执行操作），卡片中的所有数字都由代码写出。每个对话按角色记住当前客户。老板的案件对话把决定放在最前；员工只看到一行状态。虚构数据上的检查：单元测试 372，工作台 60/60，13 段脚本对话在模拟模型上 169/169、在本地真实模型上 170/170 且没有回复被扣留。评分由模型阅读者完成，人工一栏为空；未测试托管模型；第 4 版测试指南待写。仅部署到预览实例（65982b8）：通过公网地址、使用真实模型检查，三部分提问、追问、切换客户、导航、添加客户以及老板提供上下文均通过；对于超出老板所说“最多 14 天”的请求，一次建议给出了当前到期日并被代码扣留，另一次在老板回答后给出的日期在上限之内。根路径 / 的共享实例仍运行 f95f50f。

bullets.en: 21 October: on the team's direction of that day (Nucleon serves people and AI agents; shared, role-appropriate case context and a case-details tool; availability, permission and confirmation kept apart, every implemented tool on by default in the preview, nothing sent outside Nucleon; prepared decisions with one confirmation; calculable questions answered by code; suggestions on request through the guarded step; next steps from the workflow; fix the stale focus, repeated details and failed replies without phrase-specific fixes), the third slice is built on the branch (E021; P003 Revision 4; prompt coordinator-v0.4). The desk page and the agent read one role-filtered situation of the case. The agent's tools are in a registry that the owner switches under Setup → Agent tools; a tool turned off is neither offered nor run. The owner can say a decision in words and confirm the date code worked out with one button. A short answer folds its blocks under Details, and a withheld reply is asked again once. Checks on fictional data: unit suite 428, desk 73/73, 23 scripted conversations 310/310 on the mock and, after a four-round fix wave, 325/325 on the local live model at 50233e5 (3 INFO, no reply withheld, no failed suggestion). A recorded deviation: code shows a short answer that carries a figure as a summary even when the model asks for the full blocks. The rubric's reader is a model and the human column is empty; no hosted model is tested. It was deployed to the preview as df10ab6 on 21 October and checked through the public URL as both roles; the shared site at / still runs f95f50f.
bullets.zh: 10 月 21 日：按团队当天的方向（Nucleon 同时服务人和 AI agent；共享按角色过滤的案件上下文，并提供案件详情工具；可用、权限与确认三者分开，预览实例默认开启所有已实现的工具，不向 Nucleon 之外发送任何内容；准备好的决定只需一次确认；可计算的问题由代码回答；应要求给出的建议走受控的建议流程；下一步由工作流程推导；修正过时的当前对象、重复的详情和失败的回复，且不做针对特定措辞的修补），第三步在分支上完成（E021；P003 第 4 版；提示版本 coordinator-v0.4）。工作台页面和 agent 读取同一份按角色过滤的案件情况。agent 的工具登记在注册表中，老板可在“设置 → Agent tools”中开关；关闭的工具既不提供给模型，也不会执行。老板可以用文字说出决定，再用一个按钮确认代码算出的日期。简短回答把详情折叠在“Details”下，被扣留的回复会重新请求一次。虚构数据上的检查：单元测试 428，工作台 73/73，23 段脚本对话在模拟模型上 310/310；经过四轮修正后，在本地真实模型上 325/325（50233e5；3 条 INFO，没有回复被扣留，没有建议失败）。记录的偏离：即使模型要求完整显示，含数字的简短回答也由代码显示为摘要。评分由模型阅读者完成，人工一栏为空；未测试托管模型。10 月 21 日已部署到预览实例（df10ab6），并通过公开网址以两种角色核查；根路径 / 的共享实例仍运行 f95f50f。

bullets.en: 21 October, later: on the team's question of how far existing projects and frameworks can make Nucleon more natural and easier to maintain, the Nucleon Lab experiment is built and deployed as a third instance at https://nucleon.dracooz.top/lab/ (3e52328; E022; P003 Revision 5), with its own records instance and fictional data; the preview (df10ab6) and the shared site (f95f50f) are untouched. The investigation found that the review's failures came from missing business operations, not from the front end or the lack of a framework. The records server therefore gains one tool surface (GET/POST api/tools) with five operations: compare an extension without preparing it, withdraw a preparation (not a decline), a work queue across customers, requests by status, and a holding message written by code (coordinator-v0.5; not deployed to the preview). The Lab reuses Pydantic AI for its loop (prompt lab-v0.2: output validators, the reply as a tool call), assistant-ui for the chat page and MCP for external agents; Confirm stays a button that calls the records. Checks on fictional data: records unit suite 443, desk 74/74; Lab tests 87, browser check 58/58; 11 scripted conversations 188/188 on the mock and, after a two-round fix wave, 216/216 on the local live model as re-scored (lab-v0.1 was 187/205, with action claims that no tool had made). The builder's browser comparison with the preview attributes the gains to the operations. Its recommendation, for the team to review: reuse the tool surface and the UI components, keep the loop small; the framework is optional. The rubric's reader is a model; no hosted model is tested; nothing is adopted.
bullets.zh: 10 月 21 日稍后：针对团队提出的“现有项目和框架能在多大程度上让 Nucleon 更自然、更易维护”，Nucleon Lab 实验已完成，并作为第三个实例部署于 https://nucleon.dracooz.top/lab/（3e52328；E022；P003 第 5 版），有自己的记录实例和虚构数据；预览实例（df10ab6）和共享实例（f95f50f）未改动。调查发现，审查中的问题源于缺少业务操作，而不是前端或缺少框架。因此记录服务器新增统一的工具接口（GET/POST api/tools）及五项操作：只比较延期而不准备决定、撤回已准备的决定（不等于拒绝）、跨客户的工作队列、按状态列出请求，以及由代码生成的等待说明（coordinator-v0.5，未部署到预览实例）。Lab 复用 Pydantic AI 作为对话循环（提示版本 lab-v0.2：输出校验器，回复本身是一次工具调用）、assistant-ui 作为聊天页面、MCP 供外部 agent 使用；“确认”仍是直接调用记录接口的按钮。虚构数据上的检查：记录单元测试 443，工作台 74/74；Lab 测试 87，浏览器检查 58/58；11 段脚本对话在模拟模型上 188/188，经过两轮修正后在本地真实模型上重新评分为 216/216（lab-v0.1 为 187/205，出现过没有工具执行的操作声明）。构建者在浏览器中与预览实例的对比显示，改进来自这些操作。其建议供团队审议：复用工具接口和界面组件，保持循环精简；框架并非必需。评分由模型阅读者完成；未测试托管模型；没有采纳任何方案。

bullets.en: 21 October, afternoon: the Lab's second iteration (E023; P003 Revision 6; prompts lab-v0.4 and coordinator-v0.7), on the team's direction after the independent review: a natural assistant that stays understandable and dependable when the person changes their mind. A prepared decision is now a versioned proposal (current, superseded, withdrawn or confirmed). A revision keeps what the owner did not change, only the current version has Confirm, and the agent explains earlier proposals from the stored history. Replies put the prose first, with the records and the tool steps folded and one card open. A case shows its due date now and the original one, a second request on an invoice is numbered, a likely duplicate is flagged, and a case thread opens with a header. From Tony's questionnaire mock-up: the app asks the owner whether an earlier line still holds; staff can raise a concern, which puts the case in the owner's queue; and owner involvement stays explicit. One-off versus standing approval, the path that skips the reasons and the A08 question set are for the team (docs/reviews/2026-10-21-tony-questionnaire-response.md). Checks on fictional data: 18 scripted conversations, 319/319 on the mock and 354/364 on the local live model at 6038696. The reviewer's DEMO-201 sequence ran as asked, but the owner's reason was not passed at the first preparation. A second fix wave made one general change for each of the live run's six findings: the reason clause of the owner's message, a limit statement kept as guidance, no prose that repeats the open card, the app's question asked, no open holding card for a decision ask, and no 'today' about a date (model-limited). After it: records unit suite 463, desk 76/76, Lab tests 115, browser check 99/99, and the 9 affected scenarios 223/223 live (212/222 before). The Lab ran 6038696 for the afternoon's first demonstration, and a0ab50d from about 15:20 for the team's. The team imported the NTK ledger there through the Imports page; the data files stay local and out of Git, and Q08 (handling real data) is still open. The final deploy is pending. The rubric's reader is a model. The preview (df10ab6) and the shared site (f95f50f) are untouched.
bullets.zh: 10 月 21 日下午：Lab 第二轮迭代（E023；P003 第 6 版；提示版本 lab-v0.4 与 coordinator-v0.7），依据团队在独立审查后的方向：一个自然的助手，在用户改变主意时仍然清楚、可靠。准备好的决定现在是带版本的提案（当前、已被取代、已撤回或已确认）。修改时保留老板没有改动的内容，只有当前版本有“确认”按钮，agent 根据保存的历史解释之前的提案。回复先给出文字，记录和工具步骤折叠起来，只展开一张卡片。案件显示现在的到期日和原到期日，同一张发票的第二个请求会编号，可能重复的请求会被标记，案件对话以一个标题栏开头。采纳 Tony 问卷原型的想法：应用会询问老板之前说过的话是否仍然成立；员工可以提出关注，使案件进入老板的待办；老板的参与保持明确。一次性还是长期的批准、跳过理由的路径以及 A08 问题清单留给团队决定（docs/reviews/2026-10-21-tony-questionnaire-response.md）。虚构数据上的检查：18 段脚本对话在模拟模型上 319/319，在本地真实模型上 354/364（6038696）。审查者的 DEMO-201 流程按要求完成，但第一次准备时老板给出的理由没有被传入。第二轮修正针对这次真实模型运行的六项发现，各做了一处通用修改：采用老板消息中的理由从句；把额度类说法当作指引保存；文字不再重复已展开的卡片；把应用的问题向老板提出；要求做决定时不展开等待说明卡片；不用“今天”描述日期（受模型能力限制）。修正后：记录单元测试 463，工作台 76/76，Lab 测试 115，浏览器检查 99/99，受影响的 9 段脚本对话在真实模型上 223/223（修正前 212/222）。下午第一次演示时 Lab 运行 6038696，约 15:20 起为团队演示运行 a0ab50d。团队已通过“Imports”页面把 NTK 账本导入该实例；数据文件只保存在本地，不进入 Git；Q08（真实数据的处理）仍未解决。最终部署待完成。评分由模型阅读者完成。预览实例（df10ab6）和共享实例（f95f50f）未改动。

bullets.en: 21 October, evening: agent-assisted import (E024; prompts lab-v0.5 and coordinator-v0.8). Importing one spreadsheet took about 28 dropdowns and two uploads on the Records page. On the Lab, a person attaches the .xlsx or CSV in the chat; the agent reads the headings and three sample rows, proposes what the file lists (invoices, payments received or a ledger of both), the column of each field, how customers are named and how due dates are worked out, and an import card shows it with the counts and the doubtful rows. Nothing is imported until a person presses Import, which writes two reversible batches with the records' own importer; a stale version is refused. The model is asked only about columns no heading names, and sees headings and three rows. Built in b97e50b (records) and 43781d6 (Lab). Checks: records 484, Lab 119, lab_check 113/113 on scratch servers. No live-model run yet; limits are recorded in E024. The team imported a real ledger on the Lab at a0ab50d, which Q08 does not cover (open).
bullets.zh: 10 月 21 日晚：代理辅助导入（E024；提示版本 lab-v0.5 与 coordinator-v0.8）。在记录页导入一份表格大约要 28 个下拉选项和两次上传。在 Lab 中，用户直接在对话里附上 .xlsx 或 CSV；agent 只读取表头和三行样本，提出文件内容（发票、已收款项或两者的总账）、各字段对应的列、客户命名方式和到期日算法，并用导入卡片展示数量和可疑行。在有人按下“导入”之前不会导入任何内容；按下后由记录系统自己的导入器写入两个可撤销批次，旧版本会被拒绝。只有表头无法识别的列才会询问模型，模型只看到表头和三行样本。提交为 b97e50b（记录端）与 43781d6（Lab 端）。检查：记录 484，Lab 119，lab_check 在临时服务器上 113/113。尚未用真实模型运行；限制见 E024。团队曾在 a0ab50d 的 Lab 上导入真实总账，这不在 Q08 范围内（仍未解决）。

bullets.en: 21 October, night: the week 7 core flow (E025; P003 Revision 7; prompts lab-v0.6 and coordinator-v0.9), after the team meeting. The Lab now gets numbers from a fixed, tested pipeline instead of a guess: a ledger replay by code (what is overdue and for how long, earlier receipts made while something was overdue, relationship length; Hoang's feature names) checked against limits the owner sets, which gives a recommendation (approve within authority, escalate, or decline by policy). No approval model runs and no probability or percentage is shown, because the team's labels are proxies for lateness, not owner decisions (85 labelled payments, 8 denials from 3 customers). Staff act only within the owner's limits; everything else escalates; each decision records who made it, the recommendation it saw and whether it followed it; two staff concerns send a case to the owner; "from now on" carries an end date. Imports now refuse a file whose currency differs from the workspace (VND into AUD), match a payment to the invoice it names and show a proposal's live state. A customer or case that was removed is reported as gone, a failed read as unreadable, and conversations from before a records reset are read-only. Deployed to the Lab only (final code commit db86293, 01:21 AEDT on 23 October; earlier c792a43, f1cabf9, 3efe379, d74c33c, 7f6f64b, 7c6bec4; prompts at the end coordinator-v0.10 and lab-v0.7). Run live with the local model in both roles, which found eighteen issues that were fixed or recorded. On 22 October a person pressed the new New workspace console button to reset the Lab to an empty VND workspace (after backups), and on 23 October the team ledger was imported with one press and validated against the source: 21 customers, 137 invoices, 113 payments, 60 allocations, 4 opening balances (as at 2 September 2025, the file states no date); five rows left out and flagged. The owner's answer to a staff concern now sets the status and the next person (Waiting on staff); a staff reply is not a concern round; withdrawing a request is a button a person presses. No approval predictor: it would depend on validated decision records, and collecting decisions alone does not validate one. Checks at db86293: records 585, Lab 148, lab_check 174/174, desk 78/78, conversations 472/472 on the mock. Remaining: private-context trimming rests on the prompt, a few minor importer and date rules, local-model cold start, hosted APIs untested. Deferred: a trained classifier until real decisions exist, credit limits, multiple currencies, the questionnaire. Independent review and repair, 23 October: an independent browser review of db86293 found five failures, all repaired and re-checked live as owner and staff. Causes: the replay excluded same-day entries from the assessment (F1); invoice rows carried only a still-owed text, so the original amount and the matched payment were missing or invented from an absence (F2); every kind of owner answer moved the case to staff (F3); the model's quotation of the recorded decision reason was withheld as a judgement claim and the fallback hid it (F4); an internal instruction shown as an error, a static Request-opened card and a single-date comparison (F5). The earlier checks missed them because fixtures predated the as-of date, checks looked at status words and card presence rather than every requested fact, and the guidance scenario was a mock written from the implementation. Verification now uses independent hand-computed fixtures including same-day entries, fail-then-pass regressions, assertions on every requested fact, checks in both roles and an evidence table. Deployed to the Lab (both halves): 1720b0d 15:09, 08b0a07 15:27, eb8eef0 15:36 AEDT on 23 October (e2e 6/6 each; root f95f50f and preview df10ab6 untouched); prompts coordinator-v0.12 and lab-v0.10. Counts at eb8eef0: records 606, Lab 177, lab_check 185/185, desk_check 78/78, conversations 522/522 on the mock (51 live-only skipped). Remaining: broad dirty-data compatibility, no approval predictor, Act and Withdraw as buttons, private-context trimming on the prompt, hosted APIs untested, local-model cold start; docs/reviews/2026-10-22-week7-handover.md. Round F, 23 October evening: a second retest of 2c30d9f found five faults, repaired in 991cf31 (20:43 AEDT): an unknown overdue state was shown as none overdue (A); a staff decision within authority was shown as the owner's (B); an older guidance card invented a staff reply (C); a manually entered amount was labelled as the customer's words (D); the Request-opened card did not refresh while preparing (E). 196c3ee (21:12 AEDT) adds the AI Agent testing account: one code (accessCodes.agent, demo instances only, value not recorded), three sessions, the effective role being the role the request names, actor name and role in the audit trail, a Lab role switch and a Demo console link. Deployed to the Lab (both halves, e2e 6/6 each); live rows 14-25 pass. Counts at 196c3ee: records 628, Lab 187, lab_check 213/213, desk_check 89/89, conversations 530/530 on the mock; prompts lab-v0.11, coordinator-v0.12. Limits: analyses stored before 991cf31 keep the older provenance wording; model prose may still hedge about Act when the card says escalate; the Lab role switch applies only to the agent identity; import batches record AI Agent without a role.
bullets.zh: 10 月 21 日夜：第 7 周核心流程（E025；P003 第 7 版；提示版本 lab-v0.6 与 coordinator-v0.9），承接团队会议。Lab 现在用固定、可测试的流程得出数字，而不是猜测：由代码重放账本（逾期金额与天数、逾期期间的历史收款、合作时长；沿用 Hoang 的特征名），再对照老板设定的限额，给出建议（限额内批准、上报老板或按规则拒绝）。系统不运行审批模型，也不显示概率或百分比，因为团队的标签只是迟付的替代指标，不是老板的决定（85 笔标注付款，8 个拒绝来自 3 位客户）。员工只能在老板的限额内操作，其余一律上报；每个决定都记录是谁做的、看到的建议以及是否遵循；员工两次提出顾虑后案件转给老板；“从今以后”带有截止日期。导入现在会拒绝币种与工作区不一致的文件（把 VND 导入 AUD），把付款匹配到其注明的发票，并显示建议的实时状态。被删除的客户或案件会被报告为已不存在，读取失败会说明无法读取，记录重置之前的对话变为只读。已部署到 Lab（最终代码提交 db86293，10 月 23 日 01:21 AEDT；此前为 c792a43、f1cabf9、3efe379、d74c33c、7f6f64b、7c6bec4；最终提示版本 coordinator-v0.10 与 lab-v0.7），并用本地真实模型以两种角色运行，发现的问题均已修复或记录。10 月 22 日，由人按下新的“New workspace”控制台按钮（先做备份），把 Lab 重置为空的 VND 工作区；10 月 23 日一次按键导入团队账本并对照源文件验证：21 位客户、137 张发票、113 笔付款、60 笔分配、4 笔期初余额（截至 2025 年 9 月 2 日，文件未注明日期）；5 bullets.en: First-build fact and question register: docs/FACTS-AND-OPEN-QUESTIONS.md. It records verified instructions, reported evidence, proposals and the evidence needed to resolve each blocker. No MVP, model or autonomy choice is adopted by this reconciliation.
bullets.zh: 首轮开发事实与问题清单：docs/FACTS-AND-OPEN-QUESTIONS.md。分别记录已确认指令、转述证据、提案及各阻塞项需要的证据。本次核对不代表采纳 MVP、模型或自主审批方案。

bullets.en: Next evidence: cleaned data, verified extension labels, owner comfort boundaries, research-informed scenarios and a draft of measurable success criteria.
bullets.zh: 下一批证据：清理数据、核实过的延期审批标签、老板舒适边界、研究支持的情境和量化成功标准草稿。

bullets.en: Do not turn late payment into “approved extension,” or “learns as used” into a proven performance claim.
bullets.zh: 不能把晚付款直接标成“获批延期”，也不能把“越用越懂”写成已验证性能。

bullets.en: Hanting has stopped HTML maintenance. Use the Markdown project records and course-requirements note as current memory; the old page is a historical snapshot.
bullets.zh: Hanting 已停止 HTML 维护。当前记忆以 Markdown 项目记录和课程要求文档为准，旧页面仅保留历史快照。

title.en: Move work out of the owner’s day. Do not just move it into a chatbot.
title.zh: 把工作从老板身上移走，避免只是换到聊天框。

lead.en: Net time saved = current approval and information-search time − future approval, input, review, correction and maintenance time. Include setup time over an explicitly stated usage period.
lead.zh: 净节省时间＝当前审批和查资料时间－使用系统后的审批、录入、复核、纠错和维护时间。首次设置时间按明确的使用周期分摊。

rows.en: Information is scattered
rows.zh: 资料分散

rows.en: Retrieve existing records and prepare a relevant customer summary
rows.zh: 读取已有记录，整理相关客户信息

rows.en: Less searching and fewer follow-up questions
rows.zh: 查找和追问是否减少

rows.en: Context exists only in the owner’s head
rows.zh: 判断背景只在老板脑中

rows.en: Capture missing context during a real decision and reuse it later
rows.zh: 在真实决定中补充缺少的背景，后续复用

rows.en: Repeated explanations fall without excessive checking
rows.zh: 重复解释减少，且复核负担不过高

rows.en: Staff know the answer but lack authority or confidence
rows.zh: 员工知道答案，但缺授权或信心

rows.en: An explicit owner-approved delegation boundary
rows.zh: 老板明确确认的授权边界

rows.en: Staff act within it; AI advice alone may not change behaviour
rows.zh: 员工是否真的愿意执行，单靠 AI 建议可能无效

title.en: Use what already exists
title.zh: 先用已有信息

body.en: Start with available transactions, terms and notes. Avoid making the owner retell the full business history.
body.zh: 先用已有交易、条款和备注，避免要求老板重新讲完整个业务。

title.en: Ask only for missing context
title.zh: 只补缺少的背景

body.en: Attach capture to work the owner already has to do. A separate recurring interview must justify its own cost.
body.zh: 把采集附在老板本来要做的工作上。额外的定期访谈必须证明值得。

title.en: Reuse without overgeneralising
title.zh: 复用，但不随意推广

body.en: Save a decision, a customer note and a reusable policy as different things. One approval is not permission to approve all similar cases.
body.zh: 分别保存单次决定、客户备注和通用政策。批准一次不等于授权以后都批准。

bullets.en: Meeting agreement: examine work removed, work introduced and information reused. The numerical target must come from evidence, not the exploratory 10-minute/half-hour/hour examples.
bullets.zh: 会议共同讨论：减少什么工作、新增什么工作、复用什么信息。量化目标要有证据，不能采用讨论中随口举的十分钟、半小时或一小时。

bullets.en: Frequency alone is not a go/no-go test. Also consider time per case, interruptions, delays, errors and consequences.
bullets.zh: 频率不能单独决定做不做。还需考虑单次耗时、中断、等待、错误及后果。

bullets.en: Failure signal: staff still call the owner, while the owner also has to maintain the system. Record this instead of declaring the demo a success.
bullets.zh: 失败信号：员工仍要打电话，老板还多了维护系统的工作。应记录这个结果，而非只凭演示宣布成功。

bullets.en: Owner willingness to accept bounded risk was reported, but no risk ceiling, data-sharing authorisation or autonomy scope was established.
bullets.zh: 会上转述老板愿意考虑有限风险，但尚未确定风险上限、数据共享授权或自主决策范围。

title.en: A proposal is useful. A proposal is not business evidence.
title.zh: 方案有用，但方案本身不是业务证据。

lead.en: Art of Gelato, NTK and other businesses must not be combined into one fictional company. Confirm which business and interview support the first use case.
lead.zh: Art of Gelato、NTK 和其他企业不能混成一家虚构企业。第一条流程需要明确主案例企业及对应访谈来源。

rows.en: 15 October team meeting · S9
rows.zh: 10 月 15 日小组会 · S9

rows.en: Hoang’s reported owner workflow, staff capability/authority issue, conditional trust and new action commitments
rows.zh: Hoang 转述的老板流程、员工能力与授权问题、条件性信任及新行动承诺

rows.en: Owner was not present. Business attribution and exact thresholds still need confirmation; this is not independent owner validation.
rows.zh: 老板未出席，企业归属和具体阈值仍待确认，不是直接的老板验证。

rows.en: Art of Gelato owner interview · S2
rows.zh: Art of Gelato 老板访谈 · S2

rows.en: Owner workload, contextual customer knowledge, software cost and adoption concerns; credit-limit/terms entry risks
rows.zh: 老板负担、客户情境知识、软件成本与采用顾虑，以及额度和条款录入风险

rows.en: Does not directly establish frequent credit-exception calls at this company
rows.zh: 不能直接证明这家企业频繁接到信用例外审批电话

rows.en: Week 5 seminar · S1
rows.zh: Week 5 seminar · S1

rows.en: Team reports that an owner spends time approving/declining credit requests; discusses relationship and market judgement
rows.zh: 组员转述老板耗时审批信用请求，讨论客户关系和市场判断

rows.en: Confirm the business, speaker and underlying interview; speaker labels are uncertain
rows.zh: 待确认企业、说话人和原访谈，自动说话人标注不可靠

rows.en: NTK ledger structure / 9 Oct audit · S3
rows.zh: NTK 账本结构／10 月 9 日审查 · S3

rows.en: Transaction fields and limitations; old audit reports 13 months and 511 ledger rows
rows.zh: 交易字段与限制，旧审查记载 13 个月、511 行账本

rows.en: Not 511 decisions. Limits, terms, due dates, requests and outcomes are absent in the reviewed materials
rows.zh: 不是 511 条决策；已审材料缺额度、条款、到期日、请求及审批结果

rows.en: Problem Statement + backlog · S4,S5
rows.zh: Problem Statement 与 backlog · S4,S5

rows.en: Team framing, candidate functions, tentative roles and dates
rows.zh: 团队的问题表述、候选功能、暂定分工和日期

rows.en: Backlog is a classroom draft. Completion labels lack supporting attachments
rows.zh: Backlog 是课堂草稿，完成标签未附支持材料

rows.en: Claude architecture report · S6
rows.zh: Claude 架构报告 · S6

rows.en: A concrete candidate: rules + exception brief + decision capture
rows.zh: 具体候选方案：规则、例外简报和决策采集

rows.en: Not adopted. Rule generalisation, scope and assumptions need revision
rows.zh: 尚未采纳；规则推广、范围和假设需要调整

bullets.en: The meeting promise of 16 October is superseded by Hoang’s later request to deliver the cleaned data on Saturday, 17 October. He reported a follow-up owner meeting to clarify the description column and other questions. Acceptance of the revised date, meeting outcomes and data delivery have not been verified. Source: S13.
bullets.zh: 会上承诺 10 月 16 日交付后，Hoang 又申请周六 10 月 17 日提供清理数据，并表示已安排老板后续访谈，澄清 description 列及其他问题。调整日期是否获接受、访谈结果和数据交付均未核验。来源：S13。

bullets.en: In the Art of Gelato interview, the owner’s statement about making AI decisions is about adopting/trialling tools in context. It does not establish a blanket refusal of automated business decisions.
bullets.zh: 结合 Art of Gelato 访谈上下文，老板关于 AI 决定的话主要涉及采用和试用工具，不能推出他全面拒绝业务决策自动化。

bullets.en: Hoang reported (S9) that the ledger-provider company — NTK, which Hanting identified on 17 October as Nutek, a business separate from Art of Gelato and Dr. Kyan — generally uses 30-day terms with two customer exceptions, rather than an amount cap. A later team report relayed by Hanting on 17 October says three exceptions; its original source is not identified. Both are second-hand: no Nutek terms are recorded until the business confirms them.
bullets.zh: Hoang 转述（S9），账本企业——Hanting 于 10 月 17 日说明 NTK 即 Nutek，与 Art of Gelato、Dr. Kyan 为不同企业——主要使用 30 天条款，有两个客户例外，并非金额上限型政策。Hanting 10 月 17 日转述的后续团队信息为三个例外，原始来源未确认。两者均为转述：在企业确认前不录入任何 Nutek 条款。

title.en: A late payment is not proof of an approved extension.
title.zh: 晚付款不能证明获批延期。

lead.en: The meeting exposed this ambiguity and Hoang agreed to ask the owner. Retain unknown labels until the request, original terms and approval can be linked.
lead.zh: 会议识别了这一歧义，Hoang 已同意向老板核实。在请求、原条款和审批无法关联前，保留未知标签。

rows.en: Ordinary ledger transaction
rows.zh: 普通账本交易

rows.en: A sale/payment took place
rows.zh: 存在销售或收款

rows.en: It was an approved credit exception
rows.zh: 曾发生信用例外审批

rows.en: Payment beyond the reported original term
rows.zh: 超过转述原条款的付款

rows.en: Potential lateness; verify terms and invoice matching
rows.zh: 可能晚付，需核实条款和发票匹配

rows.en: The owner approved that extension
rows.zh: 老板批准过延期

rows.en: Explicit owner-confirmed extension
rows.zh: 老板明确确认的延期

rows.en: An approval example within the stated scope
rows.zh: 在说明范围内的批准案例

rows.en: All similar future requests are authorised
rows.zh: 今后所有相似请求均获授权

rows.en: No similar approved example
rows.zh: 没有相似批准案例

rows.en: Insufficient support from available examples
rows.zh: 现有案例支持不足

rows.en: A verified refusal label
rows.zh: 已核实的拒绝标签

title.en: Hoang’s experiment
title.zh: Hoang 的实验

body.en: Try a split experiment with the proposed approved examples. This was an experiment commitment, not a decision to adopt a trained approval model.
body.zh: 尝试在拟定批准案例上做划分实验。这是实验承诺，不代表采用训练型审批模型。

title.en: What it cannot establish
title.zh: 该实验不能证明什么

body.en: A test containing only approvals cannot show how often refused requests would be incorrectly approved. Unknown is different from no.
body.zh: 测试集只有批准案例，无法判断拒绝案例被错批的情况。未知与拒绝不同。

title.en: Cold-start scenarios
title.zh: 冷启动情境

body.en: Prepare plausible fictional cases using research and owner answers. Separate demonstration data from independent evaluation cases. No automatic learning schedule or method was selected.
body.zh: 用研究和老板回答准备合理虚构情境，演示数据与独立评估案例分开。尚未选定自动学习时间表或方法。

bullets.en: The second and third cards include analytical cautions from the summary. They are not reported as formal team decisions.
bullets.zh: 其中评估限制和数据区分包含整理时的分析提醒，不记作团队正式决定。

title.en: One useful request. An end-to-end record. A test of benefit.
title.zh: 一个有用请求，一条完整记录，一次价值验证。

lead.en: The v0.1 development proposal now defines one-invoice payment extensions: prototype intake, agent retrieval/clarification/approval-task preparation, owner decision, then a saved response draft. See docs/MINIMUM-FLOW.md and docs/MODULE-INTERFACES.md. Team scope and owner authority remain unconfirmed; this is not an implemented feature.
lead.zh: v0.1 开发提案现定义单张发票付款延期：原型接收、agent 查资料／补充／创建审批任务、老板决定，随后保存回复草稿。详见 docs/MINIMUM-FLOW.md 与 docs/MODULE-INTERFACES.md。团队范围和老板授权仍待确认，尚非已实现功能。

rows.en: Staff paste one customer message into prototype intake
rows.zh: 员工将一条客户消息粘贴至原型入口

rows.en: Persisted event triggers the agent
rows.zh: 保存事件触发 agent

rows.en: Agent retrieves facts/confirmed notes and creates clarification if needed
rows.zh: agent 读取事实／确认备注，按需创建补充任务

rows.en: Staff do not manually assemble the brief
rows.zh: 员工无需手工汇总简报

rows.en: Code calculates dates/balances; agent creates sourced approval brief/task
rows.zh: 代码计算日期／余额，agent 创建带来源的审批简报／任务

rows.en: Useful tool actions within checked authority
rows.zh: 在受校验权限内完成工具动作

rows.en: Owner commits approval/date change or decline
rows.zh: 老板提交批准／改期或拒绝

rows.en: Financial judgement stays with owner in v0.1
rows.zh: v0.1 财务判断由老板完成

rows.en: Save decision and response draft, then reopen
rows.zh: 保存决定与回复草稿，再次打开

rows.en: Persistent completed record; no external sending
rows.zh: 可持久化完整记录，不向外发送

title.en: Four v0.1 acceptance scenarios
title.zh: 四个 v0.1 验收情境

body.en: Complete request; missing facts; owner declines/changes date; AI failure. Initial financial outcomes require owner approval. These replace the earlier broader three-path proposal for this specification only, not as a team decision.
body.zh: 完整请求、缺资料、老板拒绝／改期、AI 失败。第一版财务结果由老板审批。这份规格取代先前三路径宽泛提案，仍不代表小组决定。

title.en: Leave out for now
title.zh: 当前暂缓

body.en: Defer financial auto-approval, other request types, live ledger/accounting/messaging integration, automatic rule publication/training and cloud deployment. The prototype draft is not sent externally.
body.zh: 暂缓财务自动审批、其他请求类型、真实账本／会计／消息集成、自动规则发布／训练和上云。原型回复草稿不向外发送。

title.en: Measure value separately
title.zh: 单独验证价值

body.en: Compare current and MVP workflows on comparable cases. Include setup/review time and check errors. Counterbalance case order to reduce learning effects.
body.zh: 用可比案例比较原流程和 MVP，计入设置与复核时间并检查错误。交叉安排案例顺序，减少熟悉题目带来的偏差。

bullets.en: The team agreed to prepare plausible fictional scenarios and seek owner decisions/reasons. Full scenario-preparation/review ownership and deadline still need assignment.
bullets.zh: 团队同意准备合理虚构情境并取得老板决定和理由，但情境准备、复核的完整分工与期限仍待落实。

bullets.en: “The system learns as it is used” is a desired behaviour. Saved examples/retrieval, rule updates and parameter training are different implementations and do not guarantee improving accuracy.
bullets.zh: “越用越懂”是期望行为。保存案例与检索、更新规则、训练参数是不同实现，均不保证准确率自动提升。

bullets.en: Week 7: maximum four content slides plus title; seven minutes total, with at least four minutes reserved for the core live demo and a recording ready if access fails.
bullets.zh: Week 7：最多四页内容加封面，总共七分钟，至少四分钟给核心现场演示，并准备访问失败时的录屏。

bullets.en: The fictional flow now runs end to end with live local-model extraction, tool selection, clarification and owner-brief preparation (DEMO-101 plus two further fictional invoices). Calculations, permissions and state stay in code; reply drafts remain templates. Real-data, business-accuracy and value validation remain incomplete. See prototype/README.md and PROMPTS.md.
bullets.zh: 虚构流程现可端到端运行：本地模型负责提取、选工具、补信息与准备老板简报（DEMO-101 及另外两张虚构发票）。计算、权限与状态仍由代码负责，回复草稿仍为模板。真实数据、业务准确性与价值验证尚未完成。见 prototype/README.md 与 PROMPTS.md。

eyebrow.en: Local skeleton implemented; model is mocked

rows.en: Current: local Gemma 4 26B-A4B via the home server's LM Studio gateway reads requests, selects permitted tools (native tool calls) and quotes customer statements; application code validates calls, enforces authority and renders all facts. No recommendations. Mock/unavailable modes remain for tests; failures use a disclosed manual fallback.

bullets.en: An extension changes dates; a new order may increase exposure; a limit increase changes a ceiling. They must not share one generic ‘balance + request amount’ calculation.
bullets.zh: 延期改变日期，新订单可能增加敞口，提额改变上限，不能统一采用‘余额＋请求金额’。

bullets.en: The scaffold uses Python standard library + SQLite + plain browser JavaScript as a reversible engineering choice, not a confirmed team production stack. The prototype calls the model already served on the home server (a community Gemma 4 26B-A4B fine-tune) through a replaceable OpenAI-compatible adapter; this is not a team model selection. AI autonomy and owner involvement still need validation.
bullets.zh: 骨架暂用 Python 标准库、SQLite 与原生网页 JavaScript，这是可替换的工程选择，并非小组确认的正式技术栈。原型通过可替换的 OpenAI 兼容适配器调用家用服务器上已有的模型（社区微调版 Gemma 4 26B-A4B），这不代表小组已选定模型。AI 自主范围和老板介入仍待验证。

bullets.en: 21 October: the Nucleon Lab (E022) is the first application code with third-party dependencies (the browser checks already used Playwright), and it is kept apart: its own venv (42 pinned packages, among them Pydantic AI 2.58.0, the mcp SDK 2.3.0, Starlette and uvicorn) and a Vite/React build for its page (Node at build time only). The records server stays standard-library only. This is an experiment, not a stack decision.
bullets.zh: 10 月 21 日：Nucleon Lab（E022）是首个带第三方依赖的应用代码（浏览器检查此前已使用 Playwright），并单独隔离：有自己的虚拟环境（42 个固定版本的包，包括 Pydantic AI 2.58.0、mcp SDK 2.3.0、Starlette 和 uvicorn），页面用 Vite/React 构建（只在构建时需要 Node）。记录服务器仍只用 Python 标准库。这是实验，不是技术栈决定。

bullets.en: Potential reuse for INFS3701 remains undecided. It does not currently require cloud migration for this MVP.
bullets.zh: 是否复用于 INFS3701 仍未决定，当前 MVP 不因此要求迁移上云。

bullets.en: The meeting did not select a framework, database, model or cloud service. Discussion of training was exploratory, not a stack decision.
bullets.zh: 会议没有选定框架、数据库、模型或云服务。“训练”的讨论是探索，不代表技术栈决定。

bullets.en: Revise the candidate architecture around a trigger and tool actions, not only a user opening a portal to ask for an explanation. No external messaging integration is selected or authorised yet.
bullets.zh: 候选架构需围绕触发和工具动作调整，不能只靠用户打开门户提问。尚未选择或授权任何对外消息集成。

bullets.en: 13 isolated HTTP checks pass for flow, clarification, changed/refused dates, access control, deduplication, stale evidence, persistence and unavailable mode. UI JavaScript syntax is checked; visual/browser interaction testing was unavailable because this environment has no browser binary. These checks do not establish business accuracy.
bullets.zh: 13 项隔离 HTTP 检查通过，覆盖流程、补信息、改期／拒绝、权限、去重、过期证据、持久化和不可用模式。网页 JavaScript 语法检查通过；本环境无浏览器可执行文件，未做真实浏览器交互或视觉测试。检查不能证明业务准确性。
